await page.locator("#fileWeekly").setInputFiles("C:\Users\arnav.bhargava\Downloads\file1.csv");

const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const sel = page.locator("select.rca-model-sel");
await sel.selectOption({ label: "Llama 3.3 70B (Groq) — fast baseline" });
const chosen = await page.evaluate(()=>document.querySelector("select.rca-model-sel").value);

for (let i=0;i<40;i++){
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  const st = await page.evaluate(()=>{
    const p = document.getElementById("investigationPanel");
    const t = p ? p.innerText.replace(/\s+/g," ").trim() : "";
    return { len: t.length, head: t.slice(0,180), hasEngine: /Engine:/.test(t) };
  });
  console.log("poll", i, JSON.stringify(st));
  if (st.hasEngine) { console.log("DONE at", (i+1)*3, "s"); break; }
}

  return { rect:[Math.round(r.x),Math.round(r.y),Math.round(r.width)], topEl: top? top.tagName+"."+top.className+" | "+(top.innerText||"").slice(0,40):null, filtersDisplay:getComputedStyle(document.getElementById("filterBody")).display };
});

  });
  console.log("poll", i, JSON.stringify(st));
  if (st.hasEngine) { console.log("COMPLETE after ~"+((i+1)*3)+"s"); break; }
}

2 actions · 256ms
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const st = await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const p = document.getElementById("investigationPanel");
  const heads = [...p.querySelectorAll("*")].filter(e=>/^(SUPPORTING EVIDENCE|REJECTED HYPOTHESES|HISTORICAL COMPARISON|FORECAST IMPROVEMENT RECOMMENDATIONS|MISSING INFORMATION|KEY FINDINGS|ROOT CAUSE|REASONING|NARRATIVE|CONFIDENCE)/i.test((e.textContent||"").trim()) && e.children.length<3);
  const secs = [...p.querySelectorAll("section,.card,.panel,[class*=sec],[class*=block]")].map(s=>{
    const h = (s.querySelector("h1,h2,h3,h4,.hd,[class*=head]")||{}).textContent;
    return { cls: s.className, head: (h||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,60), textLen: s.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,"").length, childCount: s.children.length };
  });
  const bars = [...p.querySelectorAll("[class*=bar]")].map(b=>({cls:b.className, w:Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().width), txt:(b.innerText||"").slice(0,40)}));
  return { secs, bars, hasReasoning: /REASONING/i.test(p.innerText), hasConfidenceSection: /^CONFIDENCE$/m.test(p.innerText) };
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(st,null,1));

assert-rca-quality

2 actions · 264ms
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const st = await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const rep = document.getElementById("report").innerText;
  const hdr = (rep.match(/(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*Forecast Adherence/)||[])[1];
  const find = (rep.match(/Forecast adherence\s*=\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/)||[])[1];
  const cap = /Under-forecast/.test(rep) ? "Under-forecast" : (/Over-forecast/.test(rep) ? "Over-forecast" : "none");
  const inv = document.getElementById("investigationPanel").innerText;
  const emptySecs = [...document.querySelectorAll("#investigationPanel .inv-sec")]
    .map(s=>({t:s.innerText.replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,40), len:s.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,"").length}))
    .filter(x=>x.len<40);
  return { hdr, find, cap,
    metrics: document.getElementById("metrics").innerText.replace(/\s+/g," ").trim(),
    mapBadge: document.getElementById("mapBadge").textContent.trim(),
    unmapped: [...document.getElementById("qlist").querySelectorAll('[id^="q"]')].filter(c=>/unmapped/i.test(c.innerText)).length,
    engine: (inv.match(/Engine:.*/)||[""])[0], emptySecs };
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(st,null,1));
console.log(st.hdr && st.find && st.hdr===st.find ? "PASS adherence signs agree ("+st.hdr+"% both)" : "FAIL adherence sign mismatch hdr="+st.hdr+" findings="+st.find);
console.log(/7,350 ROWS/.test(st.metrics) && /42 FORECAST NAMES/.test(st.metrics) ? "PASS row/name counts" : "FAIL counts: "+st.metrics);
console.log(st.mapBadge==="CQN mapped · 443 entries" ? "PASS mapBadge" : "FAIL mapBadge="+st.mapBadge);
console.log(st.unmapped===0 ? "PASS 0 unmapped cards" : "FAIL unmapped="+st.unmapped);
console.log(st.emptySecs.length===0 ? "PASS no empty RCA panels" : "FAIL empty RCA panels: "+JSON.stringify(st.emptySecs));
console.log(/0 field\(s\)/.test(st.engine) ? "FAIL engine footer reports 0 fields gathered" : "PASS engine footer field count");
